pytorch.reason: compute Von Neumann entropy via eigvalsh; autograd on DeltaS w.r.t. off-diagonal amplitude; load-bearing for numerical sweep

pyg.reason: not used — density matrix entropy bridge is 2x2 qubit level; no graph message-passing required

z3.reason: UNSAT proof: off_diag=0 AND gap>0 is structurally impossible — no coherences means no gap

cvc5.reason: not used — density matrix entropy bridge is 2x2 qubit level; z3 covers the proof layer

sympy.reason: symbolic eigenvalue derivation for rho=[[a,c],[c*,b]]; show |c|>0 implies S_VN > S_diag

clifford.reason: Bloch vector rho=(1+r.sigma)/2 in Cl(3,0); classical=r along e3 only; coherences=transverse r_x,r_y; bridge signal is transverse blade activation

geomstats.reason: not used — density matrix entropy bridge is 2x2 qubit level; no manifold sampling required

e3nn.reason: not used — density matrix entropy bridge is 2x2 qubit level; no equivariant network required

rustworkx.reason: bridge graph: nodes {classical, nonclassical}, edge weight = commutator norm |[A,B]|; edge present iff commutator nonzero

xgi.reason: not used — density matrix entropy bridge is 2x2 qubit level; no hypergraph topology required

toponetx.reason: not used — density matrix entropy bridge is 2x2 qubit level; no cell complex required

gudhi.reason: not used — density matrix entropy bridge is 2x2 qubit level; no persistent homology required

P1_diagonal_VN_equals_Shannon.description: Diagonal density matrix: S_VN = S_shannon (classical is special case)

P2_coherences_create_entropy_gap.description: Off-diagonal coherences → |S_VN - S_shannon| > 0; gap signals nonclassical regime

P3_noncommutativity_is_bridge_signal.description: DeltaS~0 for diagonal (commuting) state; DeltaS>0 for coherent state with nonzero commutator

P4_sympy_gap_zero_at_c0.description: Symbolic: gap = S_VN - S_diag is numerically zero at c=0 for all tested a values

P5_autograd_gap_gradient_nonzero.description: Autograd: d(gap)/dc is nonzero at c=0.3 — gap is differentiable in off-diagonal amplitude

P6_clifford_transverse_blade_bridge.description: Classical state has zero transverse Cl(3,0) blades; coherent state activates e1/e2 blades

P7_rustworkx_bridge_graph_edge.description: Bridge graph has 1 directed edge with commutator-norm weight > 0

P8_gap_monotone_in_c.description: Entropy gap |S_VN - S_shannon| is monotonically non-decreasing with |c|

N1_diagonal_gap_always_zero.description: Negative: purely diagonal state has DeltaS=0 for all diagonal mixtures

N2_z3_no_gap_without_coherences.description: Z3 UNSAT: off_diag=0 AND gap>0 is structurally impossible

N3_commuting_observables_no_bridge.description: Diagonal observables commute: commutator norm = 0, no bridge edge warranted

N4_sympy_gap_exactly_zero_at_c0_half.description: Sympy: for a=1/2, c=0 — S_VN = S_shannon exactly = log(2)

N5_clifford_no_transverse_no_bridge.description: Clifford: state with zero transverse blades is purely classical — no bridge

B1_max_coherence_pure_state_svn_zero.description: Boundary: |+> state (max coherence) has S_VN=0 (pure state); S_shannon=log(2) → maximal gap

B2_near_pure_gap_approaches_max.description: Near-maximally coherent state: gap approaches log(2) from below

B3_maximally_mixed_both_equal_log2.description: Maximally mixed diagonal state: S_VN = S_shannon = log(2); no gap

B4_z3_unsat_even_tiny_gap_without_cohere.description: Z3 UNSAT: even a tiny gap of 1e-5 is impossible without coherences

B5_isolated_classical_node_no_edges.description: Boundary: classical node with no coherences has out-degree 0 in bridge graph
